title: Broderick Jones Returns with a Powerful New Release: "What Do You Want"
htmlContent:
Kansas pop singer Broderick Jones has been making waves in the music industry since his 2014 debut, and his latest release promises to be his most powerful yet. "What Do You Want" is the first single from Broderick's new EP "Hope You're Listening," showcasing his growth as a writer and a vocalist.

Teaming up with Grammy-nominated vocalist and writer Kyl Means, Broderick has created a song that is both catchy and emotionally resonant. With background vocals and harmonies carefully placed throughout the track, Broderick showcases a side of his voice that he has never revealed. The result is a memorable and heartfelt song, guaranteed to leave listeners wanting more.

For fans of Broderick's previous work, "What Do You Want" promises to be a thrilling new chapter in the artist's career. With his unique blend of pop, R&B, and rap, Broderick has carved out a niche for himself in the music industry, and this latest release is sure to cement his place as one of the most exciting new artists on the scene.
